meta.purpose: Registry of public-records responses received and the chain from each request to the published finding. One entry per request. Structured so a future Public Records Archive page can be built from it without changing the data model.
meta.note: This registry is local, structured data. The public evidence archive it links to is an external convenience for independent inspection; ClayMoneyTrail never reads from it at runtime and works without it.

statusVocabulary.response_received_completeness_not_verif: A response was received but the original request wording has not been compared against what was produced.
statusVocabulary.fulfilled: The original request was compared with the production and everything requested was supplied.
statusVocabulary.partially_fulfilled: The original request was compared with the production and some requested items were not supplied.
statusVocabulary.open: No response, or the response is still being awaited.

responses.agency: Clay County Board of County Commissioners — Workday Accounts Payable (system export; producing department not stated in the package)
responses.subject: Supplier invoices — Find Supplier Invoices accounts-payable export

requestWording.note: The response package contains no cover letter and no copy of the original request wording — just the raw Workday report export. Requested-versus-produced cannot be compared until the original request is located.

responses.statusNote: No cover letter or dated response letter is present in this package, unlike PRR-2026-1195. The response date above is inferred from the report's own embedded generation timestamp ("Find Supplier Invoices 2026-09-18 10_32 EDT.xlsx"), not from a county-dated letter. Do not treat this request as fulfilled or partially fulfilled until the original request wording is located and compared against what was produced.
responses.description: A single Workday "Find Supplier Invoices" report export: 37,845 supplier-invoice line items (invoice number, status, supplier, supplier's own reference number, invoice date, memo, invoice amount, PO number) for the Board of County Commissioners, covering invoice dates 2024-10-01 through 2026-09-17. These are accounts-payable invoice records, not a payment/disbursement ledger — an "Approved" status means the invoice was approved for payment processing in Workday, not that funds were disbursed.

coveredPeriods.label: Invoice dates (FY2024-25 through FY2025-26 year to date)

responses.employerScope: Invoices filed under "Clay County Board of County Commissioners" in Workday only (the report's own Company filter). Does not include the constitutional offices' own independently-issued vendor invoices — where a constitutional office appears in this export (Sheriff, Clerk, Property Appraiser, Supervisor of Elections, Tax Collector), it is as the recipient of a BCC-to-constitutional-office budget-draw transfer, not as a vendor being paid by the BCC.
